Name: Spirit's Eve Costume Pack
Author: owogirlgamerowo
Description:
This mod replaces the regular Stardew Valley Portraits with portraits of the characters in costumes!

All characters have their own costume portraits based on their character design.

This mod is intended for use during the Spirit's Eve Festival however it can stay activated for them to wear their costume all year round!

!! WARNING !!

Since this mod is intended for use during Spirit's Eve, some characters don't have some expressions w/ costume as they don't appear in the festival, and some characters don't have costumes at all. The character sprites remain unedited. I plan to patch all of this in the future. 

[THIS MOD WAS MADE AS PART OF A UNIVERSITY ASSESSMENT. IF YOU WISH TO EDIT OR USE TRANSFORMATIVELY, PLEASE CREDIT ME AS THE ORIGINAL CREATOR SO AS TO NOT FLAG FOR PLAGARISM.]
